name: M11-NOV-00b ordered keyword query comparison preregistration
question: Does replacing the validation path's first-200-character hypothesis prose query with the existing deterministic ordered keyword distillation improve exact source-PMID retrieval through the maintained PubMed MCP, without losing a baseline anchor or regressing pairwise-distinct controls?

inputs.keyword_rule: Use the existing deterministic helper unchanged: tokenize in source order, remove its fixed stopwords, retain at most its first eight terms, and join with spaces. No generated query, added term, stemming, sorting, or model call.

pairs.positive_draft: In motor neurons, loss of nuclear TDP-43 may expose a cryptic polyadenylation site in STMN2 pre-mRNA, reducing functional stathmin-2 and impairing axonal regeneration.
pairs.control_draft: In Alzheimer’s disease, the UNC13A cryptic-exon risk variant may associate with cognitive decline without tracking TDP-43 pathology.
pairs.control_label: distinct from paired known-prior-art idea at the primary-source-abstract level; provisional single-curator review

candidate_queries.positive: motor neurons loss nuclear TDP-43 may expose cryptic
candidate_queries.control: Alzheimer s disease UNC13A cryptic-exon risk variant may

pairs.positive_draft: SARS-CoV-2 may require ACE2 engagement and TMPRSS2-mediated spike priming to enter susceptible human cells.
pairs.control_draft: In vascular endothelial cells, SARS-CoV-2 spike S1 may induce inflammatory dysfunction through interferon and ISG15 signaling.
pairs.control_label: distinct from paired known-prior-art idea at the primary-source-abstract level; provisional single-curator review

candidate_queries.positive: SARS-CoV-2 may require ACE2 engagement TMPRSS2-mediated spike priming
candidate_queries.control: vascular endothelial cells SARS-CoV-2 spike S1 may induce

pairs.positive_draft: In checkpoint-treated mouse tumors, interferon-gamma sensing may induce Qa-1b and restrain CD8 T cells through NKG2A/CD94.
pairs.control_draft: During murine cytomegalovirus infection, Qa-1-restricted CD8 T cells may recognize viral peptides and support host defense.
pairs.control_label: distinct from paired known-prior-art idea at the primary-source-abstract level; provisional single-curator review

candidate_queries.positive: checkpoint-treated mouse tumors interferon-gamma sensing may induce Qa-1b
candidate_queries.control: During murine cytomegalovirus infection Qa-1-restricted CD8 T cells

baseline.query: the exact frozen draft string sliced as draft_hypothesis[:200]

candidate.query: the exact frozen helper output listed per case above

arms.order: For each pair in listed order: baseline positive, candidate positive, baseline control, candidate control. Stop the entire comparison on the first retrieval error or rate limit.

request_contract.server_source: the maintained local PubMed MCP implementation in this checkout; both arms use the same code, configured pubmed_fulltext ToolConfig, pubmed_search_with_fulltext tool, parameter mapping, and ResponseParser
request_contract.server_endpoint: loopback MCP endpoint(s) for the maintained checkout only; do not switch to direct Entrez or Europe PMC
request_contract.cache_rule: Separate empty COSCIENTIST_LIT_REVIEW_DIR roots for baseline and candidate, using the same maintained server code and identical per-case slug/run_id across arms. Keep cases isolated by their per-case slug/run_id.
request_contract.call_and_paper_bounds: At most one MCP tool call per arm per draft: 12 total calls, 2 calls per draft, max_papers=3 per call, at most 6 returned paper records per draft and 36 overall. Preserve the MCP tool's existing bounded query-relaxation behavior; no extra query, retry, or pagination.
request_contract.credentials_and_cost: No API keys, email credentials, account-backed route, paid service, or model inference. Expected cost is $0. Do not print or store credential values.

outcomes.primary_metric: Positive exact-target PMID recall@3: number of the three positive drafts whose exact positive_target_pmid appears in that arm's first three parsed PubMed results; report numerator and denominator.
outcomes.adoption_threshold: Candidate positive recall@3 must be strictly greater than baseline positive recall@3.
outcomes.no_baseline_target_loss: For each positive draft, if its exact positive target PMID appears in baseline top three, it must also appear in candidate top three.
outcomes.control_non_regression: For each control draft, compare its own control_anchor_pmid in baseline and candidate top three. Candidate must not remove an anchor present in baseline; report both arm counts. The control's provisional distinct-idea label is pairwise only and does not claim global novelty.
outcomes.unrelated_hit_diagnostic: For each control, record whether its paired positive's exact target PMID appears in the top three. Report any baseline-to-candidate increase as cross-pair retrieval. A retrieval hit alone is not a novelty rejection or a semantic duplicate verdict.

retrieval_error_classification.success_nonempty: MCP returns a valid response, parser produces one or more papers.
retrieval_error_classification.success_empty: MCP returns a valid response and parser produces zero papers; never reinterpret as novelty evidence.
retrieval_error_classification.mcp_or_upstream_error: MCP isError or an exposed PubMed/Entrez service error, including 429; stop immediately.
retrieval_error_classification.transport_error: Connection, protocol, timeout, or tool-call exception; stop immediately.
retrieval_error_classification.malformed_result: Response cannot be parsed by the configured ResponseParser or has an unexpected shape; stop immediately.

outcomes.decision_rule: Adopt the minimal ordered-keyword query change only if the primary metric strictly improves, no positive baseline target is lost, control-anchor recall does not regress, and the count of controls returning their paired positive target does not increase. If all calls succeed but there is no primary improvement, record inconclusive/no adoption; empty result sets are not novelty passes. Any error or rate limit makes the comparison incomplete and stops further calls.

evidence_to_record: UTC start/end time and per-call order
fixture and helper hashes, checkout commit, maintained MCP source revision
sanitized case ID, arm, exact query, common parameters, MCP status/error class
parsed source IDs/PMIDs only, result count, positive/control anchor and cross-pair hit flags
isolated cache paths without secret values, call count, paper cap, model-call count, and cost
prohibited_changes_during_comparison: No edits to the fixture, helper, baseline query, or metric after preregistration.
No model inference, direct Europe PMC call, manual query repair, retries, or broad benchmark.
No code adoption based on empty results or exploratory earlier Europe PMC snapshots.
